text: Toyota Motor reported operating profit below estimates with continued decline despite revenue stability. Tariffs, rising costs, and investment load increase breakeven thresholds. Output and sales volumes decrease while forward guidance is reduced under ongoing external and internal pressure.

meta.note: Compression vs drift overlap; declining efficiency persists without directional recovery signal.

text: Nintendo raised console pricing due to memory cost increases tied to AI infrastructure demand. Unit sales forecasts decline while revenue and profit guidance are reduced. Hardware economics concentrate around constrained components, with demand response remaining uncertain under pricing adjustments.

meta.note: Compression vs drift overlap; cost pressure drives pricing shift without stable demand response signal.
